tasks.title: Bioluminescent Organisms
paras: Bioluminescence is the production and emission of light by living organisms. Observed in fireflies, jellyfish, and certain fungi, this light is generated through a chemical reaction involving luciferin and luciferase. Fireflies use bioluminescence to communicate, facilitating mating and deterring predators. Jellyfish use light to startle predators, providing an opportunity to escape. Some deep-sea organisms use bioluminescence for hunting, emitting light to attract prey.

Bioluminescence is not limited to animals. Certain fungi, like the ghost fungus, glow in the dark to attract insects that help disperse their spores. Scientists study bioluminescence to develop new technologies, exploring bioluminescent proteins for medical imaging and environmental monitoring. The exact mechanisms of bioluminescence are still not fully understood, despite its intriguing applications.

Ongoing research aims to uncover more about how organisms produce light and why this ability evolved. One area of interest is understanding the genetic and molecular basis of bioluminescence. As scientists delve deeper into the mysteries of bioluminescence, they may discover even more ways to harness this natural phenomenon. This has led to breakthroughs in several scientific fields, including genetics and biotechnology, demonstrating the wide-ranging potential of studying bioluminescence.

questions.stem: The word “emission” in the first paragraph is closest in meaning to
questions.analysis: 正确答案：B 题型：词汇题 原文定位：Bioluminescence is the production and emission of light by living organisms. 解析：emission 意为散发、释放、发出，和 production 并列近义。 选项分析： A. concealing 隐藏 —— 语义相反 B. production 产生、释放 —— 词义贴近，正确 C. prevention 阻止 —— 无关 D. disruption 干扰、破坏 —— 不符语境

options.A: They use bioluminescence to blind predators.
options.D: They use bioluminescence primarily for healing.

questions.analysis: 正确答案：C 题型：细节理解题 原文定位：Fireflies use bioluminescence to communicate, facilitating mating and deterring predators. 解析：萤火虫利用生物发光进行交流、求偶和威慑捕食者。 选项分析： A. 亮瞎捕食者 —— 文中无 blind 表述，错误 B. 用来捕猎 —— 深海生物用途，不是萤火虫，错误 C. 用来交流求偶 —— 完全对应原文，正确 D. 主要用于自愈 —— 无中生有

questions.stem: All of the following are true about bioluminescence EXCEPT:

options.A: It is observed in both animals and fungi.
options.B: It involves a chemical reaction with luciferin and luciferase.
options.C: It is used by jellyfish to startle predators.
options.D: It is fully understood by scientists.

questions.analysis: 正确答案：D 题型：细节排除题 原文定位：The exact mechanisms of bioluminescence are still not fully understood. 解析：科学家尚未完全弄懂生物发光的完整机制。 选项分析： A. 动物和真菌都存在发光现象 —— 原文第二段，排除 B. 涉及 luciferin、luciferase 化学反应 —— 第一段原句，排除 C. 水母用光惊吓捕食者 —— 第一段原文，排除 D. 科学家已经完全弄懂 —— 与原文相反，正确

questions.stem: What can be concluded about paragraph 2?

options.A: It provides an example of bioluminescence in non - animal organisms.
options.B: It challenges an idea presented earlier in the passage.
options.C: It elaborates on the chemical reactions mentioned earlier.
options.D: It introduces a theory explained in the next paragraph.

questions.analysis: 正确答案：A 题型：段落关系题 原文定位：Bioluminescence is not limited to animals. Certain fungi… 解析：第二段补充非动物生物（真菌） 的发光例子。 选项分析： A. 举出非动物生物的发光实例 —— 贴合段落主旨，正确 B. 反驳前文观点 —— 无反驳，错误 C. 详细解释化学反应 —— 本段不讲解反应原理，错误 D. 引出下一段要解释的理论 —— 无此种行文逻辑，错误

questions.stem: Why does the author mention medical imaging in the second paragraph?

options.A: To indicate that bioluminescence evolved primarily for scientific use
options.B: To highlight one of the potential applications of bioluminescence
options.C: To show the complexity of luciferin and luciferase reactions
options.D: To suggest ongoing research in environmental monitoring

questions.analysis: 正确答案：B 题型：修辞目的题 原文定位：exploring bioluminescent proteins for medical imaging and environmental monitoring. 解析：举例医学成像、环境监测，是为了说明生物发光的实际应用价值。 选项分析： A. 进化初衷就是为了科研 —— 完全曲解，错误 B. 强调生物发光的潜在应用领域 —— 贴合举例目的，正确 C. 说明化学反应有多复杂 —— 和生化反应复杂度无关，错误 D. 只为引出环境监测研究 —— 只是其中一个例子，不是目的
